names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 aprilie, «Sfântul Ierarh Teotim, Episcopul Tomisului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Θεότιμος Επίσκοπος Ρουμανίας», with the rank word and the see left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Pe la sfârșitul primului deceniu al secolului V, Sfântul episcop Teotim s-a strămutat cu pace din viața aceasta, la cereștile locașuri» — the end of the first decade of the fifth century, which is the interval recorded here. The same page puts his accession «pe la anii 385-390» and his last appearance at Constantinople in 403.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 aprilie — «Sfântul Ierarh Teotim, Episcopul Tomisului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ής Απριλίου — «Άγιος Θεότιμος Επίσκοπος Ρουμανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. The Greek calls him bishop of Tomis or Tomi in Lesser Scythia at the end of the fourth century, says that the barbarian Huns dwelling about the Danube, marvelling at his virtue, called him the god of the Romans, and reports from Jerome that he wrote in dialogues «Ομιλίας βραχείας και κομματικάς», short and sectioned homilies, fragments of which survive in the Parallels of John of Damascus. **Its year is more precise than the one this folder holds**: «Ο Άγιος Θεότιμος κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 407 μ.Χ.», where doxologia.ro gives only the end of the first decade of the fifth century, which this folder records as 401-410. The existing interval contains 407 and was left as it stood rather than narrowed by a reader; the narrowing is a reading for somebody else to make. Note too that the day's line calls his see «Ρουμανίας», of Romania, which is the modern country and not the page's own «Τόμεως ή Τόμων της Μικράς Σκυθίας». It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţelor, învăţător înfrânârii te-a arătat pe tine, turmei tale, adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai dobândit cu smerenia cele înalte şi cu sărăcia cele bogate; Părinte Ierarhe Teotim, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Teotim, Episcopul Tomisului», Glasul 4

english.text: A rule of faith and a model of meekness, a teacher of abstinence — so has the truth of things shown you to your flock. Therefore you gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty. Father and hierarch Theotimus, entreat Christ our God that our souls be saved.
